players.product: POLATIS optical circuit switches (OCS) for hyperscale data-center networks, plus passive fiber connectivity / fiber management systems and WDM transceiver components (Cube Optics)

quarterly_data.quarter: Huber+Suhner press release: HUBER+SUHNER increases sales in the first nine months of (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nine months 2026 (ad hoc release): order intake CHF 811.9 million, in line with the strong prior-year period; net sales up 11.3% to CHF 734.1 million (10.6% adjusted for currency, copper price and portfolio effects), with the newly acquired Ingun business unit contributing for one month; book-to-bill 1.11 at end-September. Industry: orders up 44.7% to CHF 373.3 million, sales up 31.0% to CHF 313.9 million, book-to-bill 1.19, with Aerospace & Defense and Test & Measurement particularly strong. Transportation: orders up 12.5% to CHF 229.7 million, sales up 4.7% to CHF 211.3 million, book-to-bill 1.09.
quarterly_data.figure: 9M 2026 orders CHF 811.9 million (in line with prior year); net sales CHF 734.1 million (+11.3%); book-to-bill 1.11

quarterly_data.quarter: Huber+Suhner press release: HUBER+SUHNER increases sales in the first nine months of (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Communication segment, nine months 2026: order intake fell 41.4% to CHF 209.0 million against a prior-year figure that included major orders for Optical Circuit Switches (OCS) in the Data Center growth initiative; net sales CHF 208.9 million, 4.2% below the prior year, narrowing from a 14.1% decline at the half-year, mainly because the Data Center initiative generated progressively higher sales over the year on the back of the OCS order backlog; other subsegments had lower volumes; segment book-to-bill 1.00.
quarterly_data.figure: Communication 9M orders CHF 209.0 million (-41.4%); net sales CHF 208.9 million (-4.2%, from -14.1% at H1)

quarterly_data.quarter: Huber+Suhner press release: HUBER+SUHNER increases sales in the first nine months of (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 outlook (release): Huber+Suhner continues to aim for organic sales growth of at least 10% and still expects an EBIT margin between 10.5% and 12.0%, the upper half of its medium-term target range of 9-12%, assuming inflation, exchange rates, economic developments and geopolitical conflicts do not excessively impact business.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026: organic sales growth of at least 10%; EBIT margin 10.5%-12.0%
